title: Omit used positions deterministically
description: Apply the SheetInstance used-position set to preview, pagination, and PDF planning through the canonical position order so every output omits exactly the same positions.
acceptanceCriteria: Available positions equal canonical layout positions minus the validated used-position set
Preview, PaginationPlan, printable scene, and parsed PDF contain the same remaining positions in the same order
Sparse and all-used cases are deterministic and return structured empty-capacity behavior
Equivalent normalized inputs produce equivalent plans without mutating the instance

steps.details: Add a pure function that filters TASK-47 canonical position IDs by a validated immutable used-position snapshot.
Feed the filtered ordered positions into TASK-48/TASK-49 selection and pagination rather than creating a second ordering rule.
Use the same resulting PaginationPlan for preview scene and PDF preparation, including explicit no-capacity diagnostics.
Test sparse edges, interior gaps, all-used, repeat runs, preview IDs, plan IDs, and parsed PDF placement IDs/order.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse canonical ordering and pagination plans rather than adding a new planner.
Omission avoids intentionally rendering recorded-used positions; it does not assert the sheet is safe to refeed.
Never derive a new row/column traversal for this feature.
